 ## V4 result and placement regressions
 
 The result includes observer-shutdown and drain reasons, gives unproven holder cleanup priority, and names the launcher's own writer/ownership downgrades. `idle_hold_complete` is never reported as the reason for a nonpassing result. Local regression tests exercise an actual writer exit 1, actual `production.check_source` same-cgroup refusal, and the additional launcher-only descendant-cgroup refusal. The writer inherits a parent verified outside the whole source cgroup subtree; no source resource or core helper policy is modified.
+
+The immutable V4 full run recorded 36 passing tests and one stale cleanup-reason assertion (37 tests, 65.239 seconds). V5 changes that expectation from the old generic guard failure to the intended `holder_exit_unproven`; its implementation bytes are unchanged. Historical V1/V2/V3 reviews and V4's actual failed assertion remain retained separately rather than relabelled.
